title: Gate findings
description: What a gate reviewer returns, one object per finding. Each maps to one `ledger.sh add --finding "<severity>::<location>::<claim>"` flag (core/04-ledger.md). An empty array is a pass with nothing to cite, which a fresh T3/T4 pass cannot be: it needs an `info` finding with a real location, or --evidence (core/02-gates.md).

severity.description: The four values every report groups by; ledger.sh refuses any other.

location.description: file:line, or command output. May be empty only for info and out-of-scope; ledger.sh refuses a blocking or minor finding without one.

claim.description: What is wrong, or what held. It may contain '::' (everything after the second separator is the claim). An out-of-scope claim must contain filed:<ref>.
